title: Monzo chair Gary Hoffman is leaving after some of Monzo's biggest shareholders called for his removal following the board's decision to remove TS Anil as CEO (Simon Foy/Financial Times)
summary: Simon Foy / Financial Times: Monzo chair Gary Hoffman is leaving after some of Monzo's biggest shareholders called for his removal following the board's decision to remove TS Anil as CEO — Digital bank removed TS Anil as chief last year before reinstating him to board after investor rebellion
